response.rationale: Biopsies confirm VTC metastasis and markedly elevated thyroglobulin strongly indicate metastatic thyroid cancer; R4 is the broad accurate label. R1 is plausible but less specific, while R3 is contradicted by high thyroglobulin (medullary typically low) and R2 lacks direct support.

rejected.why: Medullary thyroid carcinoma typically has elevated calcitonin, not thyroglobulin; high thyroglobulin and biopsy-confirmed VTC favor differentiated thyroid cancer.
No direct support spans; papillary subtype not specified and low iodine avidity argues against classic papillary.
Label 'vascular tumor of the thyroid' is less precise than metastatic thyroid cancer; biopsy confirms metastasis, not primary vascular tumor.
